notes: Read SKILL.md (the only file) in full. Explains how to connect to and call the BGPT remote MCP server (search_papers, lookup_paper) to retrieve claim-level evidence from scientific papers, how to read its result envelopes, and how to verify extracted evidence.

Medium because the agent calls a live third-party service that bills per returned result after a free allowance (SKILL.md:143-148), and the optional stdio-bridge config (SKILL.md:37-46) runs an unpinned `npx -y mcp-remote`. Acceptable: the skill does not register the server itself (SKILL.md:25-26), the user configures any paid key in the host's credential storage rather than in tool calls (SKILL.md:54-58), and it warns to recheck pricing and not retry quota-exhausted requests.
Search queries are sent to bgpt.pro, so users should avoid putting confidential research questions in queries. No commands, file writes, or scripts beyond the optional MCP bridge configuration.
